title: Comprehending the Xing Secret
summary: The Old Madman leaves the group. Ye Fan goes into seclusion in a mountain valley to master the Xing Secret by merging with thunder, which triggers a breakthrough tribulation; Hei Huang is struck naked, and Nannan hands him flower underpants. Hell dynasty assassins attack during the tribulation, and Ye Fan comes out at Four Poles level 3, flattens a group of Four Poles Great Perfection killers and uses the Xing Secret's speed to save Nannan from a dying assassin's last strike. Going on the offensive, he and Hei Huang find the Ancient Yin Tree at the ruins of Qingming Ancient City and post source and names to hire Hell against the holy sons; the attack reveals the Yaoguang Holy Son at Dragon Transformation level 2. Meanwhile, Yaochi invites the Yaoguang Holy Son to the Yaochi Grand Gathering. Now healed, Ye Fan heads to the Holy City to keep his promise to An Miaoyi, who has stopped dancing and angered Miaoyu Convent, while the Central States' Twin Kings arrive.
